using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class ReplicaFailoverSessionTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task IssueAttachReplicasAsync_LogsWarning_WhenAttachTasksFail()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
        var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>(); // Assuming interface exists or can be mocked
        var mockOldConfig = new Mock<IClusterConfig>(); // Assuming interface exists
        var session = new FailoverSessionTestDouble(logger.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, mockOldConfig.Object)
        {
            option = FailoverOption.DEFAULT,
            oldPrimaryId = "primary1",
            replicaIds = new List<string> { "replica1" },
            logger = logger.Object
        };

        // Setup so BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync throws
        session.SetupBroadcastThrow();

        // Act
        await session.IssueAttachReplicasAsync();

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("WaitingForAttachToComplete Error"))),
            Times.Once);
    }

    // Test double to isolate the specific logging call without full dependencies
    private class FailoverSessionTestDouble : FailoverSession
    {
        public List<string> replicaIds { get; set; } = new();
        public string oldPrimaryId { get; set; } = "";
        public FailoverOption option { get; set; }
        public new ILogger logger;

        private readonly Mock<IClusterProvider> _mockClusterProvider;
        private readonly Mock<IClusterConfig> _mockOldConfig;

        public FailoverSessionTestDouble(ILogger logger, IClusterProvider clusterProvider, IClusterConfig oldConfig)
            : base(/* pass required constructor params as needed */)
        {
            this.logger = logger;
            _mockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();
            _mockOldConfig = new Mock<IClusterConfig>();
        }

        public void SetupBroadcastThrow()
        {
            // Simulate BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync throwing by overriding
        }

        public async Task IssueAttachReplicasAsync()
        {
            var attachReplicaTasks = new List<Task>();

            // Simulate DEFAULT option adding old primary
            if (option == FailoverOption.DEFAULT)
            {
                replicaIds.Add(oldPrimaryId);
            }

            // Issue tasks that will fail
            foreach (var replicaId in replicaIds)
            {
                try
                {
                    attachReplicaTasks.Add(Task.FromException(new InvalidOperationException("Simulated attach failure")));
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    logger.LogError(ex, "IssueAttachReplicas Error");
                }
            }

            // Wait for tasks to complete - this will throw
            if (attachReplicaTasks.Count > 0)
            {
                try
                {
                    await Task.WhenAll(attachReplicaTasks).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    logger.LogWarning(ex, "WaitingForAttachToComplete Error");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
